title: predicate-category-naturality
description: The condition that a predication settling is fully C-closed: for every morphism f : q -> p in the predicate category C, the fiber action f* carries the settling value at p to the settling value at q. A fully C-closed settling is equivalently a presheaf into pointed distributive bilattices; the closure operator fires to restore this naturality.

category.description: the predicate category C whose morphisms f : q -> p (specialization edges) the settling must respect

fiber-action.description: f* is the action of f : q -> p under the predication fiber functor, restricting evidence from super-predicate p to specialized predicate q

natural-square.description: C-closed at step tau: for every f : q -> p, f*(v_tau(p)) = v_tau(q)

fully-closed.description: the naturality square holds at every step tau < lambda, so the settling is a presheaf C^op x lambda -> DBiLat_*(L)

knowledge-monotone.description: settling-functoriality: the distinguished point is monotone in the knowledge order along tau
